title: EyesFree VisionProfile
description: A user's perceptual vision-compensation choices. Contains no medical data. See docs/profile-spec.md.

ghostAxis.description: Step 1: direction of perceived ghosting. Angles counter-clockwise from horizontal: horizontal=0°, diagonal45=45° (↗↙), vertical=90°, diagonal135=135° (↖↘). outline = all directions.

intensity.description: Global multiplier for kernel weights and shadow offsets.

surfaceCompensation.description: Compress luminance (white→0.90, black→0.04) to give halos headroom.

fontScale.description: Text size multiplier hint for hosts that support it.

updatedAt.description: Informational timestamp of the last change.
